ad_candidates.note: Recommendations only. Nothing was created. The rule was applied to unrounded rates.

narrative: Social sent 1361 visits to the site in September, +6.4% on August and +114.3% on September last year, against a goal of 1400 (close).

Instagram views rose to 57500 (+43.8%) mainly because we posted more (8 to 14 posts), close to the 60000 goal; Facebook views fell to 12900 (-38.6%) because posting halved (12 to 6), not because posts reached fewer people.

Instagram's most-viewed post, "Reel: no-show math", reached 14800 views at a 9.0% engagement rate against the network's 3.1% median: a short video on no-shows, the same topic as the blog's most-read article.
LinkedIn gained 180 followers against a goal of 150 (hit), and YouTube added 138 net subscribers.
Next month: post about 12 times on Facebook again, hold Instagram at 14 posts, and test the 11 posts on the ad-candidate list as ads.
